answer: Hi! I'm FreshBot. Ask me about market hours, what's in season, or how to find a market near you.
Tap "Find Markets near you" in the hero, or open Market Directory and allow location access to sort by distance.
Right now, leafy greens, root vegetables, and herbs are in season. Check the Produce Guide for the full list.
Each market's hours are listed on its detail page. Most run Saturday or Sunday mornings, with a couple of weekday markets too.
Tap the heart icon on any market or produce card to save it. Saved items appear under the bookmark icon in the top navigation.
Every market detail page has an embedded map with its exact address — just tap "View Details" on any market card.
You can find our contact details, including a map to our office, on the Contact Us page.
FreshFind is built by Infinityx Technologies to help residents discover local farmers markets. Read more on the About Us page.
Browse the full Produce Guide to see what's typically available and which markets carry it.
